display_name: Phase1 独立源验证集冻结恢复器诊断
description: 从源 V 中不按标签抽取 4096 条，冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL、DURA 和复数频谱候选，在 clean 与三个模拟星地视图上全部预测封存后独立连接源 V 真值，不拟合或更新任何模型。
authorization: 用户要求研发 Phase1 星地恢复网络并固定地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；本次只做源 V 验证诊断，不访问 Phase3 或完整测试真值。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python; CPU only, two threads, no GPU

data.representation: 4096 deterministic sample of 27000 source V IQ [2,256]; clean and three simulated practical views
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Six source TX; V labels read only by independent scorer after sealed predictions
data.validation_ref: One source V role; 4096 IDs sampled without labels and used for diagnostic only
data.leo_config_ref: residual post_sync no extra equalization; clean, practical low suburban, mid urban and low urban

permissions.query_use: No target/test IQ, no Phase3; V truth opens only after all V predictions sealed
permissions.claim_scope: Source V random sample only; F may have used V for historical model selection; frozen mask did not train or select on V; simulated satellite is not a real link

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, original DURA, fixed source-IQ-selected complex-mask checkpoint
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: V physical IDs checked disjoint from L_s/U_s and aligned by exact source contract; fixed mask commit checked
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No V used in mask fitting/selection; F historical V model selection possible; all models fixed, no target data used
checkpoint.selection_rule: No selection: a single previously frozen candidate is compared with DURA and raw on same sampled V IDs

execution.launch_owner: Codex current chat source V diagnostic one owner
execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; two threads; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; preserve other workloads

execution.stop_rule: Only role/ID/provenance violation, output collision, nonfinite result or technical failure; do not stop for poor performance

expected_artifacts: four views x three prediction arrays

dimensions: clean and three simulated practical views
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: No model selection; report fixed DURA and candidate against true source V labels only after all views sealed

rows.method: frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL + DURA / source-selected complex mask
rows.seed_notes: Support null: Phase1 no support; data seed samples V without labels, augmentation seed controls channel draw, evaluation seed controls receiver hardware.
rows.scenario: clean plus practical low suburban, mid urban, low urban source V
rows.budget_ref: 4096 V IDs; no optimizer or model updates

notes: V role remains a single validation role and is not split into method roles; sampled IDs do not update any model or persistent statistics.
Predictions for all views are sealed before scorer reads V y; labels are not read by predictor.
No target IQ or truth; independent source V evaluation is not an independent blind target test.
